text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computers can produce paintings, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people are excited about this, while others are worried. They ask an important question: can a machine really be creative? AI can copy styles and mix ideas, but it does not have feelings or real-life experiences. Human creativity comes from emotions, memories, and imagination. A robot can make a beautiful picture, but it does not know why it matters. Perhaps the best results happen when humans and AI work together, using technology as a tool to support our own ideas.
